game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: JwJw
quote: After waiting more than  a decade for this release,   I can honestly  say that GTA 6 is the biggest  disappointment in gaming   history . While   the   graphics and   map size  are undeniably   impressive,  the core gameplay feels   completely    outdated.   Rockstar  is  still  relying on the exact   same rigid, hand-holding mission  design from ten  years ago, where stepping slightly  off the  scripted  path results in an instant mission failure.   Combine that with a forgettable  storyline and  unlikable protagonists, and you get a game that is all style and no substance.  It simply  doesn’t justify the massive hype or the absurd      price
